Name: DamRsn - NeuralNote
Description: NeuralNote v2.1.0 -- audio-to-MIDI transcription (JUCE + ggml + MuScriptor). VST3 required; Standalone and models optional. LICENSE WARNING: weights of MuScriptor (the .gguf model files) are CC BY-NC 4.0. Commercial use (e.g. recording studio work) is NOT permitted. Source files extracted from NeuralNote_Installer_Windows_x64.exe and laid out under S:\Plugins\NeuralNote\ (Standalone\, VST3\NeuralNote.vst3\, models\). The plugin writes its runtime data to %APPDATA%\NeuralNote\ (settings, logs) and downloads models into %APPDATA%\NeuralNote\models\ on first run. The VST3 bundle is a single folder (Contents\x86_64-win\NeuralNote.vst3 inside NeuralNote.vst3\); one junction at the bundle root covers the whole hierarchy.
